scripts.init: npm run up && npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.reset: npm run nuke && npm run init
scripts.prod:migrate: npm run compose:prod -- run --rm server npx prisma migrate deploy --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prod:seed: npm run compose:prod -- run --rm server npx tsx server/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run prod:build && npm run prod:up && npm run prod:migrate
